title: A client who set nothing up has one tier and no Part Sale prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client on which nobody has set up tiers or changed a matrix since the release: its Tiers list shows only Default and the Audit Log of its Matrices list shows no event.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  3. Click the General Matrix's name.
  4. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows one row: 1, Default, Active.
  • The label above the list reads 1 active tier.

Step 2:

  • Every matrix's Part Sale Matrix column reads "Same as work orders".
  • Every matrix's Tiers column reads All.

Step 3:

  • The grid shows a Cost Range column and a Default column only.

Step 4:

  • The "Separate Part Sale pricing" switch is off.
  • The tab shows the switch and its info icon, and no grid and no Edit button.
